verdict.rationale: RTX PRO 6000 is a physical workstation GPU, not a software agent or CLI tool that itself 'runs' in CI/headless automation pipelines — that capability belongs to software stacks (CUDA, frameworks) that consume the GPU, not the hardware product itself. The evidence pack focuses entirely on hardware specs (memory, ray tracing, codecs, MIG partitioning) with no CI/automation framing, confirming this is a category mismatch for the product type.
